bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 171, Number 145 (Thursday, September 4, 2025)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mr. FROST:
H.R. 5139.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Article I, Section 8, Clause 1 and 18 of the U.S.
Constitution
[Page H3862]

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committees on Education and Workforce, and Ways and Means, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

bill.title: EPIPEN Act
